title: Driver display
noSession: No session is available right now.
notAssigned: This driver is not assigned in the current session.
ambiguous: This driver has multiple assignments. Check the controller mapping.
readOnly: Race controls require the director; tyre and fuel selections require a personal driver link.
lanHint: For phones, open RaceHubOS through the LAN IP rather than localhost first.
chaosDescription: Pauses the entire race. Only the director may resume. Not a safety-rated emergency stop.
tyreHint: A request does not change tyres yet. Simulator pit stops apply automatically; physical CU changes require race-director confirmation.
tyreTokenRequired: Use your personal driver link to request tyres.
tyreRequested: Tyres requested for the next pit stop.
virtualFuelNote: Independent of the CU; confirmed simulator pit stops refuel.
damageRemaining: {{seconds}} s of race time left to repair
damageRepairHint: Complete the pit stop before the race-time deadline. Real CU repairs require director confirmation.

fuelStrategy.title: Fuel strategy for the next pit stop
fuelStrategy.estimateNote: Estimate from the median of the last five recorded lap consumptions, with at least three laps. Pace changes can alter the range.
fuelStrategy.pending: Saved: {{laps}} laps, target at least {{percent}} % (estimate at saving time).
fuelStrategy.fullTank: No individual target: the next simulator stop fills the virtual tank completely.
fuelStrategy.off: Virtual fuel is disabled for this session.
fuelStrategy.pitNote: Applied automatically on a completed simulator pit stop, without director approval. No fuel is removed if the current level is higher. CU pit signals do not execute this plan.
fuelStrategy.target: Target range after the next pit stop (laps)
fuelStrategy.invalidTarget: Enter whole laps within the tank capacity.
fuelStrategy.tokenRequired: Use your personal driver link to plan fuel.
fuelStrategy.unavailable: The pit plan is available in running or paused race/qualifying sessions with virtual fuel enabled.
fuelStrategy.saveError: Could not save the pit plan. Check the current assignment, measured laps and tank capacity; refresh before retrying.
fuelStrategy.refreshError: The server accepted the plan, but its saved state could not be loaded. Reload this page before retrying.
fuelStrategy.startHint: Set through your personal link before a race or qualifying session with virtual consumption enabled. Locked after start; CU fuel remains independent. Lap range needs measured laps first.
fuelStrategy.startInvalid: Enter a whole percentage from 0 to 100.
fuelStrategy.startSaveError: Could not save starting fuel. Refresh the saved state; the session may be starting or the selection may have changed.

personalSession: This personal driver link is bound to this session.
